Downard family · Person

George Downard

1821–1902

Open in the family tree

Names in the records
George Dowrard
Born
December 27, 1821 · Deptford, Kent, England
Died
June 12, 1902 · Price, Utah
Occupations
Painter, Carpenter

Painter from Deptford. Crossed the Atlantic on the William Tapscott in 1862; the passenger transcription records the surname Dowrard.

A passenger register records George as a painter. In Spring City, the preservation inventory associates him with house painting and carpentry. The family research reports a GD livestock brand in Sanpete County on May 24, 1876. The entry image remains to be located.
